text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
(The cheers are smaller than what I saw on TV that day,
but still, there are so many spectators for a debut race.)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: (The level of the other runners is so high...! Some are even crying—everyone's giving it their all!)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
(The Twinkle Series is...
The Twinkle Series is—)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: This is so fun~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Was that girl Matikanetannhauser?
I feel like... she's built completely different from other Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon, who debuted the other day, was pretty amazing too, wasn't she?
Something about aiming to be a Triple Crown Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: Is that so? I wonder if Matikanetannhauser will aim for the Triple Crown too? It'd be awesome if she did!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Man,
looks like next year's Classic year is gonna be fiercely contested too!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the stands, a faint sense of anticipation was born
from the potential felt in Matikanetannhauser.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Make Debut complete~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: And so, to get right to the point, there's something I'd like to consult you about.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Um...
Ever since before my debut, the expectations the Chairwoman had for me
have somehow stayed in my heart ever since."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: It's a complete mystery to me why you'd pick an ordinary Umamusume like me, but...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Still, for them to come right out and say it like that,
I think it has to mean something!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
So for now, I want to try everything
I possibly can during the Classic year!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
And so, first of all,
I want to claim the Classic Triple Crown!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Of course, of course, I know it's not going to be easy,
of course I do!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: The Satsuki Sho, where the fastest Umamusume wins; the Japan Derby, where the luckiest Umamusume wins; and the Kikuka Sho, where the strongest Umamusume wins...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Each of them is a prestigious GⅠ race you can only run once in a lifetime,
and they gather Umamusume of incredible passion!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Even so, no matter what,
I still want that Triple Crown!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Because Triple Crown Umamusume are just so dazzling and cool!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, I want it. It might be difficult,
but deep down, I really want it."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
So, what do you think?
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's taking on a challenge knowing full well how high the hurdle is.
As her Trainer, not supporting her isn't an option.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's do our best together!
Yeah, let's give it our all together!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
I'll be in your care!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's settled, first off...
we go on a warrior's pilgrimage!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I briefly mentioned it earlier, but as I am right now, it's just impossible for me.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want to boost my abilities all in one big push!
I want to sprint right up to Triple Crown level!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Specifically, well... I'd like to be able to
finish in the top 5—make the board—in GⅠ races!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, around that time—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: *gasp* *pant* *wheeze*...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ha, ha, haaa... phew.
...Ah, damn, the sky's blinding.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...I guess Tannhauser
might have finished her debut race by now."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah! One more set!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Oh, Nature! Your motivation is a perfect 100!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... "Even with a fracture, Teio hasn't given up on the Kikuka Sho."
That's what you said the other day, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our first goal is to place in a GⅠ race.
I want to prepare thoroughly
to achieve the Triple Crown next year!
